title: [GMCP 203.032.06] Operations and evidence: Transport, origin, SSRF, DNS, and endpoint security
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-032-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Network policy validates every URL and redirect, resolves and pins permitted addresses, blocks private/link-local/metadata reachability unless explicitly granted, detects DNS rebinding, enforces host/origin/TLS and certificate rules, and separates proxy trust zones. Localhost impersonation, rebinding, redirect chains, request smuggling, header confusion, downgrade and egress-bypass suites fail closed. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
